Class MapperUtils

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.openapi.visitor.MapperUtils
@Internal public final class MapperUtils extends Object
Helpers for using the JsonMapper of the selected OpenApiMapperProvider. Mapping failures are rethrown as UncheckedIOException.
Since:
8.0.0
